gen-dafont-college-gf-atkinson-hyperlegi: Fat, tube-like College strokes, tall and loud. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono lays out clipped capitals in generous spacing, and that gap between shouting and breathing is what makes this pairing work.

Big-eyed lowercase and rounds that never quite latch keep the text light beside College, whose lines never vary. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next would carry paragraph after paragraph without clogging, its open curves staying legible.
gen-dafont-college-gf-biryani: Biryani gives every e a large, clear eye and keeps its strokes uniform, so the small counters stay unclogged. College hits hard with tall, full-bodied letters; Biryani simply explains.
gen-dafont-college-gf-blinker: Thick-stroked and tall in the lowercase, College hits the page hard. Blinker holds its line thickness steady, with readable open apertures and lowercase that fills most of the height.
gen-dafont-college-gf-carrois-gothic: Strokes never swell or thin in College, and its counters are huge. Carrois Gothic, with its high-set x-height plus generous c openings, holds up well at modest body sizes.
gen-dafont-college-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC keeps every curve open at its ends and sets capitals nearly level with the lowercase. Next to College, with its plotter-smooth lines, it feels tidy and quiet.
gen-dafont-college-gf-chivo: The lowercase in Chivo crowds up toward the capitals, with daylight showing through every curved opening. And College, all smooth tube-like lines, handles the loud part while Chivo handles the talking.
gen-dafont-college-gf-chocolate-classica: Sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut give the text a friendly, open face beside College. Chocolate Classical Sans would stay readable across a full column of text, no curve closing up.
gen-dafont-college-gf-comme: College draws everything with one constant drafting-pen nib. Comme reads smoothly, its lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height, and that quiet against the loud outline above is the pairing's best trick.
gen-dafont-college-gf-cossette-texte: College builds huge counters into a lofty lowercase, every curve as stout as its stems. Cossette Texte steps in with wide-eyed e's and a prominent x-height, giving the heavy heading a clear-spoken partner.
